title: Learning Process Rewards via Reasoning State Propagation
abstract: arXiv:2609.39220v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Process reward models (PRMs) have demonstrated notable effectiveness in test-time scaling and reinforcement learning by providing fine-grained signals for evaluating intermediate reasoning states, but their training relies heavily on costly process annotations. A natural way to alleviate this dependence is to complement limited process supervision with scalable outcome supervision. However, existing PRMs often model reasoning prefixes independently, providing no explicit mechanism for effectively using final outcome to guide the learning of intermediate reasoning states. We introduce Reasoning State Propagation (RSP), which represents each reasoning prefix with a binary validity state and models transitions between successive states across the reasoning trajectory. translated_title: 通过推理状态传播学习过程奖励
translated_abstract: 过程奖励模型（PRMs）通过提供细粒度信号来评估中间推理状态，在测试时扩展和强化学习中展现出显著效果，但其训练严重依赖于昂贵的过程标注。缓解这种依赖的一个自然方式是利用可扩展的结果监督来补充有限的过程监督。然而，现有的PRMs通常独立地对推理前缀进行建模，缺乏有效利用最终结果来指导中间推理状态学习的显式机制。我们提出了推理状态传播（Reasoning State Propagation, RSP），用二进制有效性状态表示每个推理前缀，并对推理轨迹中相邻状态之间的转换进行建模。具体而言，RSP预测有效状态变为无效状态的“中断概率”，以及无效状态恢复为有效状态的“修复概率”。通过传播这些转换……
tldr: 提出推理状态传播（RSP）方法，通过为每个推理前缀建模二进制有效性状态及其“中断”与“修复”转换概率，将结果监督有效传播至中间推理状态的学习，从而减少对昂贵过程标注的依赖。
en_tdlr: Proposes Reasoning State Propagation (RSP), which models binary validity states of reasoning prefixes along with break and repair transition probabilities, enabling outcome supervision to propagate to intermediate reasoning states and reducing reliance on costly process annotations.
